name: João Oliveira - Après le § 63 - Am 9
title: REPORT on developing a new EU anti-poverty strategy
part_text: 63a. Welcomes the planned coordination between the European affordable housing plan and the upcoming EU anti-poverty strategy; welcomes, furthermore, the focus put on the Housing First approach; underlines that fighting homelessness requires resources at both Member State and EU level; calls for a dedicated budget and a new work plan for the European Platform on Combatting Homelessness under the next European Pillar of Social Rights action plan; calls for the EU ensure the eradication of homelessness by 2030 at the latest;
